field.label: Enable sensor
field.help: Start synapse-sensor at boot and keep it running.

field.label: Sensor ID
field.help: Identifier reported to the daemon (--sensor-id). Shown in the SynapseIDS capture-sources view.

field.label: Location
field.help: Free-form location label reported to the daemon (--location), e.g. "hq-rack-2".

field.label: Interface
field.help: Interface to capture from - normally WAN. Only the first selected interface is used: one synapse-sensor process captures one device (--iface).

field.label: Capture filter
field.help: Built-in filter preset (--filter). Leave on "All traffic" to capture every frame the interface sees.

field.label: Direction
field.help: Which direction of traffic to hand to the BPF device (--direction).

field.label: Send
field.help: How much of the analysis runs here on the firewall, and therefore how much crosses the link (--mode). "Raw packets" streams every frame. "Flow records" aggregates flows here and sends one record per flow — around 1.5% of the raw bandwidth on ordinary traffic. "Feature vectors only" also computes the 48 features here and sends nothing else, so no packet content ever leaves this firewall — around 1.9% of the raw bandwidth. The classifications are identical in all three modes. The two record modes need a SynapseIDS daemon that speaks SYNPOIP v2; an older one refuses the connection rather than silently falling back to sending packets.

field.label: Promiscuous mode
field.help: Also capture frames not addressed to this firewall (--promisc). Required when the interface is fed from a SPAN/mirror port.

field.label: Snap length
field.help: Bytes captured per frame (--snaplen). 262144 keeps whole frames; lower it only to save bandwidth.

field.label: Connection mode
field.help: Listen: this firewall is the TLS server and the SynapseIDS daemon dials in (--listen). Connect: this firewall dials the daemon, which works when the firewall is behind NAT (--connect).

field.label: Listen address
field.help: Listen mode only: host:port the sensor binds (--listen). Restrict this to the management interface address and add a firewall rule; do not expose it to the internet.

field.label: Collector address
field.help: Connect mode only: host:port of the SynapseIDS collector to dial (--connect).

field.label: Bearer token
field.help: Shared secret that authenticates the SYNPOIP stream. It is written to a root-only file (/usr/local/etc/synapseids/sensor.token, mode 0400) and passed as --token-file; it is never placed on a command line and never appears in the log.

field.label: Verify collector certificate
field.help: Connect mode only. When unchecked the sensor runs with --insecure-tls and any host that answers on the collector address can read your traffic. Requires the authorisation confirmation below.

field.label: Peer CA bundle (PEM)
field.help: Listen mode: certificate authority that client certificates are verified against, which also makes a client certificate mandatory (--client-ca). Connect mode: authority used to verify the collector (--ca); leave empty to use the system trust store. Saved to /usr/local/etc/synapseids/sensor-ca.pem (0444 root:wheel). One or more PEM CERTIFICATE blocks; pasting a private key here is refused.

field.label: Sensor certificate (PEM)
field.help: This sensor's own certificate (--cert). In listen mode it is the TLS server certificate; in connect mode it is the mutual-TLS client certificate. Leave both this and the key empty to let the sensor generate a self-signed certificate in memory (lab use only). Saved to /usr/local/etc/synapseids/sensor-cert.pem (0444 root:wheel). A single PEM CERTIFICATE block; put any intermediates in the CA field above.

field.label: Sensor private key (PEM)
field.help: Private key belonging to the certificate above (--key). It must be unencrypted: the sensor runs unattended and cannot be prompted for a passphrase, so an encrypted key is refused here rather than failing at start-up. Saving verifies that it parses and that it really matches the certificate above. Saved to /usr/local/etc/synapseids/sensor-key.pem, mode 0400 owned by _synapseids, tightened immediately after rendering and re-checked before every start. It is never written to sensor.conf, never passed on a command line and never logged. If it is missing, empty or unparseable the service refuses to start and names the path; it never falls back to an unverified transport.

field.label: I am authorised to monitor this traffic
field.help: Required before the sensor can be enabled. synapse-sensor refuses live capture without --authorized (PROJECT.md 28.18). Only monitor networks you own or have written permission to monitor.
